title: Measuring Wi-Fi Signal Attenuation Through Common Wall Materials with ESP32
body:
This project started with a problem at home: gaming ping of 150-300 ms in the farthest room of the house, but noticeably lower in a glass-walled room at a similar distance from the router. I wanted to know how much of that comes from the walls themselves.

I built a controlled test bench with two ESP32 DevKit V1 boards, one as an access point and one as a station, placed 6 ft apart at a height of 3 ft. Specimens of glass, gypsum board, plywood, wood, brick, concrete and a 10-inch wall were placed between them, and I logged 30 RSSI readings per condition, plus a no-obstruction baseline. I wrote the transmitter and receiver firmware in Arduino C++. I analysed the data in Python (NumPy and SciPy), computing attenuation relative to the baseline with Welch confidence intervals, Mann-Whitney checks, and ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis tests across materials. The analysis also accounts for autocorrelation between consecutive readings.

title: उदेश्य || Purpose
body:
उद्देश्य छ है तिम्रो, नबिलाउनु यो भिडमा,
 विगतका अदृश्य कर्तव्य आइलाग्यो यो शिरमा ;
उसले भन्छ छैनन् मेरा जीवनमा उद्देश्य कुनै, 
तिमी पनि भगवान के अंश हो आखिरमा;

पछ्याउँदै आउनेछ तिमीलाई यसले ज्ञात हुनेछन् अन्तिममा, 
बिना उद्देश्यका छैनन् बनेका मानिस, 
यो दुखद घडीमा नखोज तिमी अल्झिन्न ,
बल्झिन्न खोज्छ यो बारबार छोड्देउ तिमी यसलाई सम्झिन्न, 
गर्दिन्न नभन आफ्नो कर्तव्य ,तिम्रा उद्देश्य मान्ने छैनन् फर्किन्न;

जोस आँसु हर्ष क्रोधले भरिएको जीवन 
पलपलमा सूक्ष्म राख्छौ, 
तिम्रा दाहयक तिम्रो पक्षमा छन्
तिमी यिनलाई केका लागि साच्छौ; 

नभुल्नु त्यो दिन जुन दिन तिमी पाउँछौ, 
नसुन्नु विगत र भविष्य गुनगुनाएको, 
सुमसुमाएको ती कमजोरीले कमजोर बनाएको, 
खनाएको तिमीमा उग्रअखण्डता घमण्डता विनम्रता;
